name: Plugin Sentinel
author: Acxel Orozco
description: Advanced plugin security audit: risk scoring, capability mapping, native DLL/SO/dylib inspection, trusted baselines, hash watchdog, public watchdog API, installable watchdog builder, sandboxed Sentinel addons with hash pinning, process sandbox, runtime monitor with plugin-execution control, policy gates, Health Guard integration, reports and CI-friendly CLI.
dependency_note: psutil is optional and improves Runtime metrics. Inject it into target plugin_sentinel to keep it Sentinel-private.
